newsitem.title: USA: Maine Yankee nuke plant restart unpredictable - NRC.
newsitem.headline: Maine Yankee nuke plant restart unpredictable - NRC.

text.p: U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission chairwoman Shirley Jackson and Maine Yankee operations officials said Tuesday they could not predict when the Maine Yankee nuclear plant in Wiscasset would be able to restart operations.
"We can't give a date," Jackson told reporters after a briefing by Maine Yankee to the commission about its efforts to correct serious equipment problems.
The plant has been shut down since December because of an electrical cable problem. The NRC put the plant on its watchlist of problem nuclear plants last week.
"I wouldn't want to be in the mode of predicting a schedule at the moment," Maine Yankee vice president of operations Graham Leitch said. "Our focus has to be on safety," he said.
Maine Yankee is owned a group of utilities including including Northeast Utilities, New England Electric System, and Central Maine Power Co.
